entries.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer (COLOR-ONLY edit).
Asset type: existing portfolio print card.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Input image 2 is ONLY a COLOR PALETTE reference, never a composition or material reference.
Primary request: Recolor image 1 to harmonize with the soft vintage futuristic palette of image 2, keeping image 1's design intact.
Keep the large painted blue embossed text panel on white paper. Recolor the paint to muted slate/periwinkle blue, the white to milky white with the faintest mint cast. Preserve existing glossy paint shading and engraved letters.
Palette: smoky muted blue-gray/periwinkle, milky white, pale mint, restrained blush pink only where an existing accent permits. Keep text legible and intentional midtone contrast.
Strict invariants: Preserve image 1's exact composition, original aspect ratio, all typography/wording, illustrations, photographs, shapes, spacing, margins, print grain and paper texture. Output the complete flat artwork edge to edge, no surrounding scene.
Change COLORS ONLY. Do not add liquid shapes, orbs, bubbles, flowers, resin/chrome materials, new objects, new lettering, borders, embellishments, gradients or glows. Do not copy image 2's design. Do not flatten the existing texture or wash out the lettering.
